claim: The Oriole BCM4389 path can associate with an operator-authorized Wi-Fi network and carry ordinary IP traffic, then recover after a controlled disconnect.
oracle: The phone reports a connected wlan0 with a DHCP lease; a numeric HTTPS request succeeds; DNS resolves a public name; after link loss and restoration the interface reacquires an address and the same HTTPS probe succeeds. All temporary radio state is removed or the watchdog recovery path remains armed.

user_journey.scenario: User opens the Linux phone away from USB, selects a saved network, runs an Agent API request, loses coverage briefly, and returns to a working connection.
user_journey.expected: Connection, address, name resolution and HTTPS are visible; a failed association leaves a bounded diagnostic result and the existing Android slot remains the recovery path.

invariants: Only slot-B Linux runtime and temporary /run state are touched
Firmware and calibration stay in the private phone stage; no proprietary bytes or credentials enter the repository
The firmware_class path is restored before teardown
The PCI endpoint is unbound before host and PHY removal
No claim is made from wlan0 creation alone
gitnexus: External pinned kernel subtree is not indexed; direct call-site and runbook audit used
ast: Existing W2 teardown helper refuses host removal after endpoint-unbind failure

unit.red: A live probe without the temporary firmware path fails with Direct firmware load and must not be reported as an association attempt.
unit.green: The corrected probe sets the private firmware path, produces wlan0, and reaches the userspace association stage without kernel fault.

limitations: The authorized SSID and password are supplied at runtime and are intentionally absent from this file.
The current overlay has no restricted DMA pool; this remains a development-only test.
One successful association does not prove suspend, cellular, camera or production readiness.
exit_gate: Record association, DHCP, DNS, HTTPS and reconnect evidence without a kernel/storage fault, then update the public README and release evidence with only redacted facts.
